Be part of our team!
AT&S is a leading global manufacturer of high-end IC substrates and printed circuit boards. AT&S industrializes leading-edge technologies for its core business segments Mobile Devices & Substrates, Automotive & Aerospace, Industrial and Medical and high-performance computing for AI applications. We are looking for talent eager to shape the future of our interconnected world. With plants in Austria, China, India, Malaysia and sales offices around the globe, we offer excellent career opportunities for creators, innovators and enablers with the drive to make a difference.

 

To enhance our successful Information Technology Team in Leoben, Austria, we are looking for a passionate 1 Specialist CoE IT S&I Endpoint Your Responsibilities

 Administer, maintain, and continuously optimize the Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) environment.

 * Manage software deployment, operating system deployment, and patch management across the enterprise.

 * Ensure endpoint security through client hardening, BitLocker, Windows Hello for Business, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and security baseline management.

 * Monitor client health, troubleshoot issues, and ensure high deployment and compliance rates.

 * Manage Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, and device enrollment processes in hybrid environments.

 * Support Entra ID, Conditional Access, and Microsoft 365 endpoint management initiatives.

 * Develop reports and dashboards to monitor compliance, inventory, and endpoint performance.

 * Contribute to the modernization of endpoint management services and the transition toward a secure hybrid workplace.

 Your Profile

 Completed IT education (HTL, FH, university, or equivalent qualification).

 * Several years of professional experience in IT infrastructure, including at least 5 years of hands-on experience with MECM/SCCM.

 * Strong knowledge of software deployment, patch management, and operating system deployment.

 * Experience with Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Windows Autopilot, and Microsoft 365 endpoint management.

 * Good PowerShell scripting skills and experience with automation.

 * Working knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, SQL Server, and SSRS.

 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with a structured and reliable way of working.

 * Good written and spoken English skills.

 * High level of ownership, quality awareness, and team orientation.

Our Offer

 A meaningful role with opportunities for long-term growth in an international environment 

 * Chance to actively contribute to AT&S' success and to create value 

 * A structured and tailor-made onboarding program along with continual training opportunities

 * Modern company canteen with freshly prepared meals every day

 * Free parking spaces and available e-charging stations

 * Diverse health measures and a wide range of employee benefits

 Ready for a new challenge to advance your career? It's just a click to apply online. We look forward to your application and your detailed resume. Your AT&S Team!

At Lam Research, we create equipment that drives technological advancements in the semiconductor industry. Our innovative solutions enable chipmakers to power progress in nearly all aspects of modern life, and it takes each member of our team to make it possible.

Across our organization, our employees come to work and change the world. We take on the toughest challenges with precision and accuracy. We push for the next big semiconductor breakthrough. We lead the way in one of the most critical and fast-moving industries on the planet. And we do it together, with deep connections and limitless collaboration.

The impact we have on the world is made possible by focusing on our people. So we recognize and celebrate our teams achievements. We strive to create an inclusive and diverse culture where everyone s contribution and voice has value. We evaluate and evolve our offerings, so our people receive the support and empowerment to do meaningful things for their lives, careers, and communities.

Because at Lam, we believe that when people are the priority and they re inspired to unleash the power of innovation for a better world together, anything is possible. 1 Process Engineer (all genders) LOCATION: Villach, AT, 9500

REQ ID: 200982

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 * Responsible for performing professional process engineering research, development and evaluation in semiconductor environment

 * Reviews processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture, fabrication and evaluation of products including in-house lab demonstrations

 * Conceives and plans projects involving definition and selection of new concepts and approaches

 * Works with customer and senior engineers cross functionally to understand roadmaps, process flow, inflection points, requirements and business issues/ challenges.

 * Acts as customer technology manager in the planning, data collection, analysis and reporting

 * Acts as single point of contact accountable for process related customer requests

 * Drives introduction and evaluation of new technologies at customer sites including new tool qualification

Other Job Responsibilities

 * Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience; may lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements

 * Works with cross-functional teams to get information and results needed

 * Flexibility to travel to meet business requirements

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 * MSc in in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering or Physics with with no previous professional experience; or equivalent experience preferably in the field of wet clean/advanced packaging 

 * Familiarity with working in a chemical laboratory, having experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques

 * In-depth understanding and experience in Statistical Process Control (SPC) and Design of Experiments (DOE)

 * Excellent social skills with ability to work within diverse teams

 * Creative thinking and strong problem-solving capabilities, able to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment with competing priorities

 * Excellent oral and written communication skills and presentation skills in English

WHAT WE ARE OFFERING

This position is subject to the https://www.metalltechnischeindustrie.at/fileadmin/content/Dokumente/Kollektivvertrag/KV-2025_2026/FMTI_Mindestgehaltstabelle_2026.pdf in the occupation group F depending on educational background. A higher payment is negotiable depending on education, expertise and skills. The monthly salary is paid 14 times per year.

Flexitime model 38,5 hours/week, Core hours (Mo-Th 9-15, Fr 9-11:30)

jobs.occupation: Power Electronics Engineer (f/m/d) Medium Voltage & High-Power Conversion Systems - JOB ID: 268343
jobs.description: 1 Power Electronics Engineer (f/m/d) Medium Voltage & High-Power Conversion Systems - JOB ID: 268343  * As part of our interdisciplinary team, you support the design, development and validation of high-power isolated power converters up to MW range as well as the development of converter topologies for medium-voltage applications up to 30 kV. * You design and optimize DC/DC, AC/DC, and DC/AC converters as well as solid-state transformer architectures. * You contribute to the development of resonant and soft-switching topologies and support the integration of medium voltage high frequency transformers, medium-voltage insulation systems, and high-frequency magnetic components. * You perform electrical, thermal, and magnetic simulations using tools such as PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, LTspice/PSIM, and ANSYS Maxwell or other FEM-based tools. * You define power-stage architectures, including semiconductor selection (SiC, IGBT, MOSFET), gate-driver design, protection concepts, and EMC/EMI mitigation measures. * You collaborate closely with mechanical, control, and system engineers to ensure successful end-to-end product integration. * You ensure compliance with relevant industrial standards, safety requirements, and certification guidelines. * You use real-time-simulation platforms (PLECS RT BOX and OPAL-RT) for basic testing of developed hardware. * You work on research and development projects, prepare technical reports and scientific publications, and present research results to customers, research partners, and colleagues. * You represent the company's expertise in medium-voltage and high-power engineering to customers, partners, and other external stakeholders. * You contribute to the scientific and technical advancement of the field by participating in international conferences and engaging in technical committees.Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner: * Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field. *  Experience in power electronic systems * Expertise in medium voltage systems (up to 20 kV), high-power converters (up to MW), and isolated converter topologies. * Understanding of medium-frequency transformer design, medium-voltage insulation systems, magnetic components, and thermal management. * Experience with wide-bandgap semiconductors (SiC preferred) * Knowledge of power converter control strategies, including closed-loop control, PWM techniques, and digital control systems. * Familiarity with laboratory equipment for medium-voltage testing and power analysis * Ability to troubleshoot complex power electronic systems * business-fluent English ; German skills are a nice to have. What to expect: * The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 61.334,--. The actual salary will be determined individually, based on your qualifications and experience. In addition, we offer company benefits, flexible working conditions (incl. Home-Office) and individual training and career opportunities. * Mentorship and training in embedded firmware and power systems * The opportunity to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge power converter technologies in a collaborative and innovative engineering environment.  At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants. Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates and documents, as well as a proof of identity.Link: https://jobs.ait.ac.at/Job/268343 Das Mindestentgelt für die Stelle als Power Electronics Engineer (f/m/d) Medium Voltage & High-Power Conversion System...
